newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo Motor opens $1.2 bln car assembly complex.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Motor opens $1.2 bln car assembly complex.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Motor Co on Monday opened a new plant, with an annual production capacity of 300,000 cars, in the southwestern city of Kunsan.
The new plant has raised Daewoo Motors's annual vehicle production capacity to 1.6 million units, including one million in domestic plants, a company spokesman said.
Daewoo Motor, a unit of the Daewoo Group and South Korea's third-ranked carmaker, plans to produce Nubira compact sedans both for domestic and overseas markets at the new plant.
Nubira is one of three passenger car models that the company introduced this year and which the company's chairman said would decide the company's future.
"I can't imagine failure for the three new models. If the new models fail, there's no future," Kim Tae-gou told Reuters.
The other two new models are the Lanos and Leganza.

Daewoo officials said earlier this month the Lanos and Nubira were the country's best sellers in March and orders for the Leganza during the first seven days of April already had broken the highest monthly record for a single model.
Kim was attending a ceremony to celebrate completion of the complex, the Kunsan Motor Park, which includes an export pier with a shipping capacity of over 200,000 vehicles per year.
Daewoo Motor president Yang Jae-shin said at the ceremony the company's goal was an annual production and sales capacity of 2.5 million vehicles by the year 2000.
It said it would expand its overseas production capacity to 1.5 million units per year from the current 600,000.
During the ceremony, Prime Minister Koh Kun said he believed completion of the complex would provide the momentum the Korean economy needs to restart its economy.
Daewoo plans to sell 885,000 vehicles this year, including 400,000 in overseas markets, compared with last year's overall sales of 653,098 units, including 352,916 abroad.
Daewoo Motor, which earned 23 billion won in net profits in 1996 on sales of 4.3 trillion won, has set its target at 70 billion won in profits this year on sales of 6.8 trillion won.
